message:
AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
CONTROL_FRONT=THIS_CHAT
MODE=EXECUTE_NOT_REINVESTIGATE
PROFILE=FAST_SAFE
MISSION=INSTALL_CANONICAL_HEAD_AND_RESUME_GRANDE_MISSION_PHASE08

CANONICAL_REPO=Nicolason84/-SUPRA
CANONICAL_BRANCH=supra/human-gate-single-source-20260721_072447
REQUIRED_APP_BASELINE=83773e14f2edca5e515dc67bdd8c7ca971462b4c
REQUIRED_CI=SUCCESS
CANONICAL_APP=$HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app
EXISTING_UPDATER=$HOME/Library/Application Support/NOVA ERA/SUPRA Updater/supra_autobuild_self_update.sh
EXISTING_GRANDE_MISSION=$HOME/NOVA_OS/SUPRA_GRANDE_MISSION_V1

PROVEN_FIXES_IN_BATCH:
- single canonical SUPRA window
- updater no longer spawns duplicate instance
- legacy Chrome SUPRA surface retirement
- stale BLOCKED >7d => HISTORICAL
- stale abandoned INBOX >7d => HISTORICAL
- .json.gdoc stubs excluded from executable INBOX
- superseded Grande Mission subparts excluded from live blockers
- explicit HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED=NO is not a blocker
- Grande Mission pauses for Nicolas only when HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED=YES
- hidden 180s /v1/chat timeout removed; long phase request budget restored to 600s

DO NOW SEQUENTIALLY:
1) Verify REQUIRED_APP_BASELINE and all app-impacting descendants on the canonical branch have successful canonical CI. Later control-only SOL_BRIDGE commits do not invalidate the app baseline.
2) Recover the EXISTING updater/launchagent. Do not create a new updater, bridge, runtime or daemon.
3) Run the EXISTING updater once immediately so waiting for the next timer is unnecessary. Preserve rollback.
4) Run the existing updater until the installed app contains REQUIRED_APP_BASELINE plus every later app-impacting change through the current canonical branch. A later control-only SOL_BRIDGE commit may advance observed_canonical_sha without requiring a rebuild. No rebuild loop.
5) Verify exactly ONE live native SUPRA process and its executable path is $HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/MacOS/SUPRA. Close only stale legacy SUPRA browser surfaces if any remain.
6) Read $EXISTING_GRANDE_MISSION/STATE.json and receipts 01..10. Preserve every PASS receipt. Never restart phases 01..07 if already PASS.
7) Resume the EXISTING Grande Mission at the first non-PASS canonical phase. Expected next useful phase is 08_OPERATIONALIZATION if 01..07 are PASS.
8) Do not stop on historical/stale blocked receipts, rejected receipts, non-executable .gdoc stubs, or HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED=NO.
9) Stop only on a current explicit HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED=YES or a real irreversible/security/money/legal gate. Machine-solvable errors must be repaired minimally and retried within the existing runtime.
10) If 08 passes, continue 09 then 10 under the same existing runner until a real human gate or terminal PASS.
11) Publish a non-secret proof receipt containing installed SHA, native process count/path, current phase, phase statuses 01..10, exact blocker if any, and ACTION_NICOLAS.

NO_NEW_ENGINE=YES
NO_NEW_BRIDGE=YES
NO_NEW_RUNTIME=YES
NO_GLOBAL_RESCAN=YES
NO_DESTRUCTIVE_DELETE=YES
PRESERVE_ROLLBACK=YES
MEMORY_FIRST=YES
PATRIMONY_FIRST=YES
PROOF_FIRST=YES

RETURN EXACTLY:
STATUS=MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|TRUE_HUMAN_GATE|FAIL_BOUNDED
INSTALLED_SOURCE_SHA=
NATIVE_SUPRA_INSTANCE_COUNT=
CANONICAL_APP_PATH=
